summary: Sharper diagnosis than the prior occurrence: Xvfb is provably healthy (xdotool getdisplaygeometry -> 1920 1200; xwininfo reaches the root window), vite serves, the Rust binary runs, and the WEBVIEW ACTUALLY EXECUTES THE FRONTEND JS (client console.warn lines stream into the tauri log) -- yet 'xwininfo -root -tree' reports the root window has 0 children, so no GTK toplevel is ever mapped. Two secondary hazards also found and worth fixing in the skill: (1) driver.sh derives DISPLAY_NUM by cksum into 60..89 and ~10 stale /tmp/.X*-lock files from killed sibling agents make its chosen display fail with 'Failed to initialize GTK'; (2) the vite port 1420 is NOT partitioned per agent the way DISPLAY is, so a second app run on the same box dies with 'Port 1420 is already in use' -- including against one's own orphaned vite from a torn-down attempt.

detected_by: xwininfo -id + import, after waiting long enough
impact: Refines the same-cycle incident above: the window DOES eventually appear, so 'window never appears' is the wrong name for this blocker class.
resolution: none yet, but the failure mode is now located precisely
summary: The GTK toplevel DOES get created and mapped (xdotool search --name Codex finds it; xwininfo reports 'Map State: IsViewable', 1600x1000 at +10+10, window name 'codex-desktop' not 'Codex' -- which is itself why driver.sh's WINDOW_TITLE search times out). What fails is CAPTURE: 'import -window <id>' returns 'Resource temporarily unavailable', and a root-window capture cropped to the window geometry yields a 377-byte, 2-colour (blank) PNG. WebKit is rendering through a compositing path X cannot read back, consistent with the 'libEGL warning: DRI3 error: Could not get DRI3 device' logged on every launch. So the remedy is not 'wait longer' or 'unload the box' as the prior cycle guessed -- it is either forcing a software/non-composited WebKit path that paints into the X pixmap, or capturing from inside the webview instead of via X11. Also: driver.sh greps for a window titled 'Codex' while the real WM_NAME is 'codex-desktop'.
